submission.natural_language_explanation: L11H10 is a copy/induction head: when the position it sits at already has an earlier counterpart in the window, it attends to the token that filled that slot before (weight 0.6-0.98, typically 10-80 tokens back) and copies it into its write, so it peaks on the function word or subword boundary immediately before a repeated content word ('while the' before the second 'treble' attends ' tre'; 'and' before 'abatement' attends ' ab'; ' with' before the second 'FRED' attends ' FR'; 'parts.' in code attends 'er' from an earlier 'parts.erase'; 'KEY_' before 'HOME' attends 'R' from an earlier 'KEY_RIGHT'). It stays near its mean (attention back on the text's first token) where no earlier token fills the slot, i.e. in prose that keeps introducing new content, and the trigger is the earlier occurrence: changing the earlier mention drops the peak while changing the later one does not.

Founded in the spring of eighteen ninety, the municipal water board inherited a network of wooden conduits laid by private contractors during the previous decade. Records from that period are fragmentary, yet they agree on one point: the earliest reservoir was little more than a widened millpond, fed by a brook that dried up most summers. When the drought of nineteen hundred and two emptied it entirely, engineers proposed a masonry dam higher up the valley. Construction took four years, employed nearly six hundred labourers, and buried two of them beneath a collapsed scaffold. The dam still stands, although its parapet was rebuilt after a rockfall in nineteen sixty-eight.

Below the dam, a cast iron main follows the old coach road toward the town centre, passing beneath an orchard that once belonged to the bishop. Because the pipe was laid before modern survey methods, its alignment wanders; crews repairing a leak often discover the main a metre or two away from the drawings. Shopkeepers on the high street complain whenever excavation closes the pavement, and each winter the council promises better scheduling, a promise nobody remembers by June.

Filtration arrived later than in neighbouring districts. Until nineteen thirty-five, sediment settled in two open basins beside the cricket ground, and residents were advised to boil anything drawn from the kitchen tap. A typhoid scare that autumn finally persuaded the aldermen to fund a covered plant with sand beds and a chlorination room. The plant's first chemist, a quiet woman named Hesketh, kept meticulous notebooks in which she recorded turbidity, alkalinity and, on one memorable page, the taste of the finished product, which she described as faintly of chalk.

Demand doubled after the war. New estates climbed the western slope, each with bathrooms and gardens and washing machines, and the old mains began to fail under the pressure. During the nineteen seventy-six heatwave, tankers stood in the market square for eleven days while welders patched a rupture beneath the bridge. That winter the board commissioned a second trunk line, tunnelled through sandstone rather than following the valley, a decision that cost far more than the estimate but ended the seasonal shortages.

Today the system draws from three sources: the upper reservoir, a borehole near the abbey ruins, and an emergency connection to the regional grid. Telemetry reports flow, pressure and chlorine residual every fifteen minutes to a control room staffed around the clock. Most of the apparatus is ordinary and forgettable, yet its reliability depends on a few neglected fittings. Ratepayers grumble about the bills, though few recall how close the town came to rationing in the summer of nineteen ninety-five. Last March, during routine maintenance, the crew finally replaced the copper valve that had seized in the pump house. Once the copper valve turned freely, water reached every standpipe in the lower district.

explanation_scores.explanation: L11H10 is a copy/induction head: when the position it sits at already has an earlier counterpart in the window, it attends to the token that filled that slot before (weight 0.6-0.98, typically 10-80 tokens back) and copies it into its write, so it peaks on the function word or subword boundary immediately before a repeated content word ('while the' before the second 'treble' attends ' tre'; 'and' before 'abatement' attends ' ab'; ' with' before the second 'FRED' attends ' FR'; 'parts.' in code attends 'er' from an earlier 'parts.erase'; 'KEY_' before 'HOME' attends 'R' from an earlier 'KEY_RIGHT'). It stays near its mean (attention back on the text's first token) where no earlier token fills the slot, i.e. in prose that keeps introducing new content, and the trigger is the earlier occurrence: changing the earlier mention drops the peak while changing the later one does not.
